source_document: OECD - The Agentic AI Landscape and Its Conceptual Foundations (Feb 2026)

key_findings.bm25_dominance: BM25 achieves 66-69% accuracy across all tiers with flat ~1800 tok/q cost
key_findings.agent_collapse: Agent gets only 17% accuracy at smallest tier (18 docs), 9.1x BM25 token cost
key_findings.long_context_wall: Matches BM25 accuracy at small scale but fails beyond 200K tokens, 81x cost at T2
key_findings.token_multiplier: Agent burns 9.1x more tokens than BM25 for 4x worse accuracy
key_findings.mechanism: BM25 corpus-wide ranking beats agent sequential exploration at any scale
